question:
Answer the following question which is based on the given four letter clusters.

STED, LAYM, JOEK, CLDP

If in each of the clusters, each letter is changed to the next letter in the English alphabetical order, how many letter clusters thus formed will have no vowel?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7d12502c2ca7d9724c6b72807e815218baf7d8f4c343b106b5314067691645b.png] 

Now, Each letter is changed to the next letter in the English alphabetical order, then:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e52bf0b1183145f7e19cd651bc38791653bf5386416142caff3b320b60ebb2e.png] 

Here, **2 such clusters formed with no vowels: MBZN & KPFL.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
